sql_query: SELECT o.produce_name AS PRODUCE_NAME, SUM(o.sales) AS "Total Sales" FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS} GROUP BY o.produce_name ORDER BY SUM(o.sales) DESC LIMIT 10
description: Top 10 products by total sales (respecting page slicers).

sql_query: SELECT o.sub_category AS SUB_CATEGORY, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS DOUBLE)) END AS "Return Rate %", CASE WHEN SUM(o.sales) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (SUM(o.profit) / SUM(o.sales)) END AS "Profit Margin", SUM(o.sales) AS "Total Sales" FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o LEFT JOIN tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_returns r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS} GROUP BY o.sub_category ORDER BY SUM(o.sales) DESC
description: Per sub-category: return rate, profit margin, and total sales (slicer-aware).

sql_query: SELECT o.region AS REGION, SUM(o.sales) AS "Total Sales", COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS "Total Orders", CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS DOUBLE)) END AS "Return Rate %" FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o LEFT JOIN tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_returns r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS} GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY SUM(o.sales) DESC
description: Regional scorecard: total sales, order count, and return rate (slicer-aware).

query_name: Total Sales by Year and SEGMENT
sql_query: SELECT YEAR(o.order_date) AS Year, SUM(CASE WHEN o.segment = 'Consumer' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Consumer, SUM(CASE WHEN o.segment = 'Corporate' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Corporate, SUM(CASE WHEN o.segment = 'Home Office' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS "Home Office" FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS} GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_date) ORDER BY Year
description: Pivoted total sales by year with separate columns for each key segment.

sql_query: SELECT o.ship_mode AS SHIP_MODE, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS "Total Orders" FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS} GROUP BY o.ship_mode ORDER BY "Total Orders" DESC
description: Total distinct orders by shipping mode (slicer-aware).
